author: R.J.R
text: I have smoked Camels for years.
I really don’t want to see Joe go!
If it does happen I wouldn’t change because of it.
But what the Surgeon General said worst.
But, “my 16 year old son tells me Camels are in the zoo, he doesn’t see Joe and say I want to smoke, so if you can’t fight it and if we can, we’ll help!”
They make toothpaste that taste like bubble gum, that means I gonna run out and buy it to see if I can blow bubbles with it, yea right?
P.S. Make a T-Shirt with Joe taking a hike & put on it Joe is hiking but he’s going every where, all us Camel lovers would love it.
